purpose: Reference-directed head base colour on existing UV layout. This is synthetic source material, not a photographic scan.
art_direction: Preserve UV island layout; match supplied Roman target skin/identity, real pores, pigment, dense brows and beard transition. De-lit diffuse colour with no directional light, specular highlights or sweat.
registration: tools/assets/build_roman_portrait.py; nose/lip rows aligned to measured source UVs; neck/tattoo seam blended back to supplied head colour. Scalp, brows and beard underpaint use independent hair response; exposed lips retain skin response.
runtime_maps: 2K colour/RM, supplied anatomical normal; 1K SSS/roots/fibre atlas. No new high-resolution body maps.

registration_landmarks_model.name: MediaPipe Face Landmarker
registration_landmarks_model.purpose: Diagnostic 2D landmark ratios, not an identity/quality score or source of game geometry. Beards/lighting/camera can bias measurements.

construction_notes: No face photo is pasted onto screen-space geometry; the generated colour is UV-registered on the existing fully skinned head.
Skin relief remains the supplied tangent-space anatomical normal plus existing tiled microdetail.
Beard clumps are generated on the already fitted source geometry and share its skin/skeleton; source card geometry remains available as the fitting authority.
Neutral and posed captures are full rendered frames. Diagnostic comparison crops will not retouch pixels.
